scenarios.description: Debate whether humans should build cities on Mars
scenarios.your_side: You believe people should live on Mars
scenarios.context: Technology is improving every year

scenarios.description: Debate whether robots should replace humans in daily chores
scenarios.your_side: You support robots doing housework
scenarios.context: Modern homes are becoming smarter

scenarios.topic: Magic would make the world better
scenarios.description: Debate whether magical powers would improve human life
scenarios.your_side: You believe magic would help people
scenarios.context: Imagine everyone could learn simple magic

scenarios.topic: Every city should have more parks than buildings
scenarios.description: Debate whether green spaces are more important than new buildings
scenarios.your_side: You support building more parks
scenarios.context: Cities are becoming crowded

scenarios.topic: Animals should be able to travel on airplanes
scenarios.description: Debate whether pets should always travel with their owners
scenarios.your_side: You believe pets should be allowed
scenarios.context: Many people consider pets part of the family

scenarios.description: Debate whether people from the future should be forbidden from speaking about what they know.
scenarios.your_side: You believe time travelers must never reveal future events to protect the present.
scenarios.context: A visitor from the year 2150 arrives and claims they can prevent a major disaster if they speak freely.

scenarios.description: Debate whether advanced robots should celebrate their own creation day every year.
scenarios.your_side: You believe robots with emotions and memories should have personal celebrations just like humans.
scenarios.context: A popular robot assistant asks its family to throw a party on the day it was first turned on.

scenarios.description: Debate whether intelligent animals should be allowed to own forests and rivers.
scenarios.your_side: You believe smart animals that can communicate deserve legal ownership of natural spaces.
scenarios.context: Scientists discover a group of talking elephants that demand the right to control their own valley.

scenarios.description: Debate whether people should record and share their dreams every night using special devices.
scenarios.your_side: You believe recording dreams would help people understand themselves and solve mysteries.
scenarios.context: A new device can film your dreams while you sleep and play them back the next morning.

scenarios.description: Debate whether humanity should move into giant cities that float in the sky.
scenarios.your_side: You believe floating cities would protect people from floods, earthquakes, and crowded land.
scenarios.context: Engineers have built the first cloud city that can house one million people above the clouds.

scenarios.description: Debate whether people with superpowers should need official permission before using them.
scenarios.your_side: You believe uncontrolled superpowers are too dangerous and must be regulated like driving cars.
scenarios.context: A teenager discovers they can fly and freeze time, and the government wants to register every power.

scenarios.description: Debate whether people should be allowed to buy and sell their personal memories.
scenarios.your_side: You believe selling memories could help people heal from pain or experience new lives.
scenarios.context: A shop opens where customers can purchase someone else’s happiest day or remove their worst memory.

scenarios.description: Debate whether visitors from other planets should compete in human sports competitions.
scenarios.your_side: You believe alien athletes would make sports more exciting and bring new skills to the games.
scenarios.context: A peaceful alien team arrives and asks to join the next world championship in running and swimming.

scenarios.description: Debate whether human clones should receive the exact same legal rights as original humans.
scenarios.your_side: You believe clones are full people and must not be treated as copies or property.
scenarios.context: The first human clone reaches adulthood and applies for a passport and a job at a major company.

scenarios.description: Debate whether perfect virtual reality trips should replace real-world tourism forever.
scenarios.your_side: You believe virtual travel is better because it protects nature and lets everyone explore freely.
scenarios.context: A company offers a headset that makes you feel the exact wind, smell, and temperature of any place on Earth.

scenarios.description: Debate whether living forever should be restricted to only a small number of people.
scenarios.your_side: You believe unlimited immortality would cause overpopulation and remove the meaning of life.
scenarios.context: Scientists invent a safe treatment that stops aging completely, and governments must decide who receives it.

scenarios.description: Debate whether technology that can read thoughts should ever be allowed in public places.
scenarios.your_side: You believe mind-reading devices would destroy personal freedom and trust between people.
scenarios.context: A new helmet can detect lies and hidden emotions in any crowded room within seconds.

scenarios.description: Debate whether large dragons should be hired to protect modern cities from danger.
scenarios.your_side: You believe dragons would be powerful and loyal protectors if treated with respect.
scenarios.context: A group of peaceful dragons offers to live above cities and stop storms, fires, and invaders.

scenarios.description: Debate whether ordinary people should have the right to visit other planets for short holidays.
scenarios.your_side: You believe space tourism should be open to all, not only the extremely rich.
scenarios.context: Cheap rockets now allow weekend trips to the Moon, and tickets cost the same as a normal vacation.

scenarios.description: Debate whether intelligent animals that can speak should be allowed to testify in court cases.
scenarios.your_side: You believe speaking animals can give important truth and should have a voice in justice.
scenarios.context: A clever parrot and a trained dolphin claim they witnessed a crime and want to tell the judge.

scenarios.description: Debate whether living inside a perfect computer simulation counts as a real and meaningful life.
scenarios.your_side: You believe a simulation that feels completely real is just as valuable as physical life.
scenarios.context: Scientists prove that our entire world might already be a simulation created by a higher civilization.

scenarios.description: Debate whether certain scientific discoveries that could destroy the world should be erased forever.
scenarios.your_side: You believe some knowledge is too dangerous and must be permanently removed to protect humanity.
scenarios.context: Researchers find a formula that can create unlimited energy but also destroy entire continents if misused.

scenarios.description: Debate whether versions of yourself from parallel universes should influence major life decisions.
scenarios.your_side: You believe advice from parallel versions of yourself could lead to wiser and safer choices.
scenarios.context: A machine opens a window to five different versions of you living completely different lives.

scenarios.description: Debate whether advanced artificial intelligence should be allowed to become elected leaders of cities.
scenarios.your_side: You believe AI leaders would make fairer and more efficient decisions than human politicians.
scenarios.context: An AI system wins a city election by promising zero corruption and perfect planning for traffic and energy.

scenarios.description: Debate whether people should be allowed to change past events if they can prove it creates a better future.
scenarios.your_side: You believe carefully changing history is acceptable if it prevents great suffering and saves lives.
scenarios.context: A team of time travelers discovers they can stop one major historical disaster without creating larger problems.

scenarios.topic: Dragons Should Be Kept as Pets
scenarios.description: Debate whether families should be allowed to raise tamed dragons at home.
scenarios.your_side: You believe dragons make wonderful and safe family pets.
scenarios.context: A breeder has created gentle, house-sized dragons that can live peacefully alongside humans.

scenarios.description: Debate whether every person should be given a single superpower at birth.
scenarios.your_side: You believe giving everyone a superpower would make the world better.
scenarios.context: A new machine can grant one power to each newborn, but nobody can choose which one.

scenarios.topic: Talking Animals Should Go to School
scenarios.description: Debate whether animals that can now speak should attend classes with children.
scenarios.your_side: You believe talking animals should learn in schools next to humans.
scenarios.context: After a strange discovery, many animals have started speaking and want to learn to read.

scenarios.topic: Cities Should Float in the Sky
scenarios.description: Debate whether future cities should be built high above the clouds.
scenarios.your_side: You believe floating sky-cities are the best place for people to live.
scenarios.context: Engineers have built the first floating city, and thousands of families want to move in.

scenarios.topic: Robots Should Do All the Cooking
scenarios.description: Debate whether kitchen robots should replace human cooks completely.
scenarios.your_side: You believe robots should prepare all of our meals.
scenarios.context: New robot chefs can cook any dish perfectly, faster than any human ever could.

scenarios.description: Debate whether humans should use a pill that removes the need for sleep.
scenarios.your_side: You believe a world without sleep would give people better lives.
scenarios.context: Scientists invented a safe pill that lets people stay awake and healthy forever.

scenarios.description: Debate whether all normal cars and roads should be removed for flying cars.
scenarios.your_side: You believe flying cars should completely replace roads.
scenarios.context: A company has released cheap flying cars that anyone can learn to fly in a day.

scenarios.topic: Every Home Should Have a Robot Twin
scenarios.description: Debate whether each person should own a robot copy that does their chores.
scenarios.your_side: You believe everyone should have a robot twin to help them.
scenarios.context: A factory now builds robot twins that look and act exactly like their owners.

scenarios.topic: Memories Should Be Bought and Sold
scenarios.description: Debate whether people should be allowed to trade their memories like objects.
scenarios.your_side: You believe buying and selling memories should be legal and normal.
scenarios.context: A new device lets people copy a memory and sell it to strangers who want to feel it.

scenarios.topic: AI Should Be Allowed to Vote
scenarios.description: Debate whether intelligent AI beings should have the right to vote in elections.
scenarios.your_side: You believe advanced AI should be given the right to vote.
scenarios.context: AI systems have become so smart that some argue they deserve a voice in decisions.

scenarios.topic: Mars Should Be Only for Explorers
scenarios.description: Debate whether Mars should be reserved for scientists instead of tourists.
scenarios.your_side: You believe Mars should be kept only for explorers and researchers.
scenarios.context: The first Mars base is ready, and rich tourists are now demanding vacation trips there.

scenarios.description: Debate whether people should visit places in perfect VR instead of traveling.
scenarios.your_side: You believe VR should replace real-world travel for everyone.
scenarios.context: New VR worlds feel so real that visiting them is cheaper and safer than flying abroad.

scenarios.topic: Aliens Should Be Invited to Earth
scenarios.description: Debate whether we should openly welcome a peaceful alien species to our planet.
scenarios.your_side: You believe we should invite the aliens to live among us.
scenarios.context: A friendly alien ship has offered to share their knowledge if we let them settle here.

scenarios.topic: Mind-Reading Should Be Used in Court
scenarios.description: Debate whether machines that read thoughts should be used to judge if someone lies.
scenarios.your_side: You believe mind-reading machines should be used to find the truth in court.
scenarios.context: A device can now read a person's honest thoughts, and judges want to use it in trials.

scenarios.topic: Kids Should Choose Their Own Age
scenarios.description: Debate whether a new technology should let children pause their aging.
scenarios.your_side: You believe children should be allowed to freeze their age if they want.
scenarios.context: A pill can stop a person's aging, and some kids want to stay young for many years.

scenarios.description: Debate whether hidden groups guarding ancient secrets should share them with the world.
scenarios.your_side: You believe secret societies should reveal all their knowledge to everyone.
scenarios.context: A powerful hidden group admits it has guarded world-changing secrets for centuries.

scenarios.topic: Humans Should Choose to Live Forever
scenarios.description: Debate whether people should be allowed to become immortal and never die.
scenarios.your_side: You believe humans should be free to choose immortality.
scenarios.context: A treatment now stops death completely, but the world must decide who can use it.

scenarios.description: Debate whether time travelers should be allowed to change history's biggest mistakes.
scenarios.your_side: You believe we should use time travel to fix past disasters.
scenarios.context: Time travel is now real, and a team is ready to go back and prevent old tragedies.

scenarios.topic: Copies of People Should Have Rights
scenarios.description: Debate whether cloned humans who share your memories deserve their own freedom.
scenarios.your_side: You believe human copies should have the same rights as anyone else.
scenarios.context: A machine now makes perfect copies of people, and the copies say they deserve to be free.

scenarios.topic: We Should Wake People From the Simulation
scenarios.description: Debate whether to tell everyone that our world is actually a giant simulation.
scenarios.your_side: You believe everyone deserves to know the truth about the simulation.
scenarios.context: A scientist proves our world is a simulation and must decide whether to tell the public.

scenarios.topic: Talking Pets Should Be Kept Secret
scenarios.description: Debate whether animals gaining the ability to speak should be revealed to the world.
scenarios.your_side: You believe talking animals must be hidden from the public to protect them.
scenarios.context: A new collar has been invented that translates animal thoughts into perfect human speech.

scenarios.topic: Everyone Should Have Just One Superpower
scenarios.description: Debate if giving people a single magical ability will make the world better or worse.
scenarios.your_side: You argue that giving everyone one superpower will create too much chaos.
scenarios.context: A strange meteor shower has given everyone on Earth the option to choose exactly one superpower.

scenarios.topic: Flying Cars Should Replace All Roads
scenarios.description: Debate whether cities should destroy all streets and only use flying vehicles.
scenarios.your_side: You believe getting rid of roads for flying cars is a brilliant step forward.
scenarios.context: A tech company has made cheap, perfectly safe flying cars available to the public.

scenarios.topic: Vacations On Mars Are a Bad Idea
scenarios.description: Debate the safety and value of sending regular families on space holidays.
scenarios.your_side: You believe Mars vacations are an incredible opportunity everyone should try.
scenarios.context: The first affordable travel agency for Mars has just opened its ticket sales.

scenarios.topic: Robot Chefs Are Better Than Humans
scenarios.description: Debate whether machines should replace all human cooks in restaurants.
scenarios.your_side: You argue that robot chefs lack the heart and creativity of human cooking.
scenarios.context: A new restaurant opens where every meal is prepared perfectly by advanced machines.

scenarios.description: Debate if simple magic tools should be sold like everyday groceries.
scenarios.your_side: You believe selling magic wands in standard shops is incredibly dangerous.
scenarios.context: A wizarding company has started stocking simple spell-casting wands next to the milk and bread.

scenarios.description: Debate whether we should use machines to schedule rain, sunshine, and snow.
scenarios.your_side: You think controlling the weather will solve global problems and prevent disasters.
scenarios.context: A massive satellite system now allows humans to change the weather with a simple remote control.

scenarios.topic: Sleep Should Be Replaced By A Pill
scenarios.description: Debate if it is better to take a pill for rest instead of sleeping for eight hours.
scenarios.your_side: You argue that natural sleep and dreaming are too important to lose.
scenarios.context: A pill can keep you awake and healthy. You never need to sleep again.

scenarios.topic: Time Travel Vacations Should Be Banned
scenarios.description: Debate if tourists should be allowed to visit the past for fun.
scenarios.your_side: You believe time tourists will accidentally ruin the present by changing history.
scenarios.context: A new machine allows anyone to spend a weekend in ancient Rome or the Jurassic period.

scenarios.topic: AI Should Decide Your Perfect Career
scenarios.description: Debate if an intelligent system should analyze your skills to pick your job.
scenarios.your_side: You argue that an AI classifier would perfectly match people to jobs they love and excel at.
scenarios.context: A computer looks at your skills and tells you the best job for you.

scenarios.topic: Mysterious City Portals Should Be Explored
scenarios.description: Debate if humanity should send explorers into strange magical gates that just appeared.
scenarios.your_side: You believe entering the portals is a huge mistake that will bring unknown monsters to our world.
scenarios.context: Glowing magical gates have suddenly opened in the center of every major city, leading to mysterious underground dungeons.

scenarios.topic: People Should Be Able to Sell Memories
scenarios.description: Debate whether trading happy memories for money is a fair practice.
scenarios.your_side: You think selling memories is a great way for people to earn money if they choose to do so.
scenarios.context: A new clinic allows you to permanently extract a happy memory from your brain and sell it to someone else.

scenarios.topic: We Should Live In A Perfect Simulation
scenarios.description: Debate if moving into a flawless virtual reality is better than the real world.
scenarios.your_side: You argue that abandoning reality for a fake, perfect world is a terrible idea.
scenarios.context: Scientists offer you the chance to upload your mind into a computer where you never feel pain or sadness.

scenarios.topic: Having A Personal Clone Is Dangerous
scenarios.description: Debate if people should be allowed to grow a copy of themselves to do their chores.
scenarios.your_side: You believe having a clone will make life much easier and stress-free.
scenarios.context: A laboratory now sells exact physical copies of yourself that follow your basic commands.

scenarios.topic: Dinosaurs Should Be Brought Back As Pets
scenarios.description: Debate the safety of genetically recreating miniature dinosaurs for families.
scenarios.your_side: You argue that mini-dinosaurs would be terrible, destructive house pets.
scenarios.context: Geneticists have figured out how to hatch harmless, dog-sized triceratops for the pet market.

scenarios.topic: Cities Lit Only By Glowing Plants
scenarios.description: Debate if all streetlights should be replaced by bio-engineered neon plants.
scenarios.your_side: You believe a dark city aesthetic with high-contrast glowing cyan plants is the beautiful future we need.
scenarios.context: Botanists have created trees that glow brightly at night, offering a modern alternative to electric streetlights.

scenarios.topic: Immortality Should Only Go To Scientists
scenarios.description: Debate if only the smartest minds should be allowed to live forever.
scenarios.your_side: You argue that restricting immortality to a specific group is deeply unfair.
scenarios.context: A rare cure for aging has been discovered, but there is only enough to treat one thousand people.

scenarios.description: Debate if judges should use technology that reveals a suspect's true thoughts.
scenarios.your_side: You believe mind-reading in court violates human privacy and is highly unethical.
scenarios.context: A flawless headset has been invented that instantly projects a person's memories onto a screen.

scenarios.topic: Earth Should Hide Its Location From Aliens
scenarios.description: Debate whether we should stop broadcasting signals into deep space.
scenarios.your_side: You argue that reaching out to alien civilizations will lead to advanced technology and peace.
scenarios.context: Astronomers have discovered a way to send a map of Earth's exact location to every corner of the galaxy.

scenarios.description: Debate the ethics of draining power from parallel universes to fuel our own.
scenarios.your_side: You argue that forecasting and optimizing our own energy consumption is safer than stealing from other dimensions.
scenarios.context: Engineers have built a machine that pulls endless, free electricity from a parallel universe.

scenarios.topic: We Should Give Animals Human Rights
scenarios.description: Debate whether intelligent animals deserve the same legal rights as humans.
scenarios.your_side: You believe animals with high intelligence should have human rights.
scenarios.context: A new study proves that dolphins, elephants, and octopuses have self-awareness and emotions like humans.

scenarios.topic: Time Travel Should Be Illegal Forever
scenarios.description: Debate whether time travel should be permanently banned, even if it becomes possible.
scenarios.your_side: You believe time travel is too dangerous and should never be legal.
scenarios.context: Scientists announce they are close to creating a working time machine.

scenarios.topic: Robots Should Replace All Dangerous Jobs
scenarios.description: Debate whether humans should be completely removed from dangerous occupations.
scenarios.your_side: You believe robots should take over every dangerous job immediately.
scenarios.context: A construction company wants to replace all human workers with robots to prevent accidents.

scenarios.topic: Everyone Should Have a Personal AI Assistant
scenarios.description: Debate whether AI assistants should be mandatory for every person.
scenarios.your_side: You believe everyone should have a free AI assistant to improve their lives.
scenarios.context: A tech company offers to give every citizen a personal AI that can manage their daily life.

scenarios.description: Debate whether humans should start building cities on Mars right now.
scenarios.your_side: You believe humanity must start colonizing Mars as soon as possible.
scenarios.context: Rockets are ready to take the first 100 people to Mars, but many say it's too risky.

scenarios.description: Debate whether superheroes must reveal their real names to the government.
scenarios.your_side: You believe superheroes should register to ensure public safety.
scenarios.context: Cities are seeing more superheroes, but there is no system to hold them accountable.

scenarios.topic: Dreams Should Be Recorded and Shared
scenarios.description: Debate whether people should be able to record their dreams and post them online.
scenarios.your_side: You believe dream recording is a wonderful idea that everyone should try.
scenarios.context: A new device allows people to replay their dreams as videos, but many fear privacy invasion.

scenarios.topic: Smartphones Should Be Banned for Children Under 16
scenarios.description: Debate whether children should be prohibited from using smartphones until age 16.
scenarios.your_side: You believe smartphones damage young minds and should be banned for children.
scenarios.context: A new study shows that smartphone addiction is increasing rapidly among children.

scenarios.topic: People Should Trade Memories Like Currency
scenarios.description: Debate whether humans should buy, sell, and trade their memories.
scenarios.your_side: You believe memory trading would be beneficial for society.
scenarios.context: A company invents a device that lets people copy and transfer memories to others.

scenarios.topic: We Should Bring Extinct Animals Back to Life
scenarios.description: Debate whether de-extinction technology should be used to revive extinct species.
scenarios.your_side: You believe bringing back extinct animals is a good idea.
scenarios.context: Scientists can now clone animals from ancient DNA, including mammoths and dodos.

scenarios.topic: People Should Work Only Four Days a Week
scenarios.description: Debate whether the five-day workweek should be reduced to four days.
scenarios.your_side: You believe a four-day workweek would make people happier and more productive.
scenarios.context: A large company tries a four-day workweek and sees amazing results.

scenarios.topic: AI Should Be Allowed to Create Art
scenarios.description: Debate whether AI-generated art should be considered real art.
scenarios.your_side: You believe AI can create true art that deserves recognition.
scenarios.context: An AI painting wins a major art competition, causing a huge debate among artists.

scenarios.topic: Parents Should Be Licensed Before Having Children
scenarios.description: Debate whether people should pass a test before becoming parents.
scenarios.your_side: You believe parenting licenses would create better childhoods for everyone.
scenarios.context: Governments are considering a new law that requires a parenting exam.

scenarios.description: Debate whether cloning humans should be allowed for medical and personal reasons.
scenarios.your_side: You believe human cloning has the potential to save lives.
scenarios.context: A doctor successfully clones a human cell and wants to create a full human being.

scenarios.topic: Virtual Reality Should Replace Real Schools
scenarios.description: Debate whether traditional schools should be replaced by VR classrooms.
scenarios.your_side: You believe VR schools would be more effective than traditional education.
scenarios.context: A new virtual reality program makes learning interactive and available to everyone.

scenarios.description: Debate whether humanity should send a message to aliens right now.
scenarios.your_side: You believe we should make contact with alien life as soon as possible.
scenarios.context: Astronomers discover a distant planet that may have intelligent life.

scenarios.topic: People Should Be Forced to Recycle Everything
scenarios.description: Debate whether recycling should be mandatory and strictly enforced.
scenarios.your_side: You believe mandatory recycling is necessary to save the planet.
scenarios.context: The Earth's waste problem has become critical, and governments are creating new laws.

scenarios.topic: Immortality Should Be Offered to Everyone
scenarios.description: Debate whether technology should give everyone eternal life.
scenarios.your_side: You believe immortality would be the greatest gift to humanity.
scenarios.context: Scientists have discovered a way to stop aging, but it's extremely expensive.

scenarios.topic: Humans Should Let AI Control the Government
scenarios.description: Debate whether artificial intelligence should replace human politicians.
scenarios.your_side: You believe AI would make better and fairer decisions than humans.
scenarios.context: An AI has been designed to make political decisions with no human bias.

scenarios.topic: We Should Destroy All Nuclear Weapons
scenarios.description: Debate whether every country should completely eliminate nuclear weapons.
scenarios.your_side: You believe the world must destroy all nuclear weapons to survive.
scenarios.context: There is a global summit to decide the future of nuclear weapons.
